text:
maya_k: Quick runbook check — we have a candidate for SWE2 tomorrow 10:00am PT. Panel as listed on the invite: Carmen (PM), Ryan (Infra), Anika (Runtime). Can everyone confirm availability + who owns the debrief?

carmen_l: Confirmed for 10, I can own the debrief and notes.

ryan_b: Heads up I'm in a client call 9:30–10:30 PT. I can join at ~10:35 and do infra questions after the coding session. If someone can swap to handle first 10–20m infra, great. @anika_p you good to start with design?

anika_p: Yep I can kick off with system design and take the first half. Fine to hand off infra to Ryan when they join.

maya_k: Thanks. Two quick ops things: please set co-hosts on Zoom (Carmen + Anika) and disable waiting room so interns/observers can join quickly. Zoom link in calendar: https://zoom.us/j/1234567890

oncall-bot: Reminder: on-call handoff scheduled at 10:15 PT. If panel needs any prod checks, please coordinate with SRE.

carmen_l: Rubric question — are we using the latest rubric? I thought we updated weights for SWE2 last month.

maya_k: Yes use rubric v3 (shared in handbook). Short snippet for scoring:

```text
- Ownership: 1-5
- System design: 1-5
- Coding: 1-5
- Communication: 1-5
```

And the weights for SWE2 are: coding 30%, design 35%, ownership 20%, comms 15%.

ryan_b: Cool. Also add a small perf/caching follow-up question (~10 min) during design. That helps assess infra tradeoffs.

anika_p: For observers: do we give edit access to the debrief doc or comment-only? I usually set comment-only and tag the debrief owner to copy out notes.

carmen_l: Comment-only pls — I'll collate after and publish summary in #hiring-updates.

maya_k: Plan: I'll update the invite with agenda + link to debrief doc and grant Carmen edit. Agenda = 10m intros, 25m coding, 20m design, 10m perf, 15m Q&A.

carmen_l: Sounds good. Also I'll add a short checklist in the doc: recording yes/no, timezone on calendar, resume pinned.

anika_p: One more: can someone confirm interview room access for our external interviewer? They need guest Zoom pass and badge for office.

maya_k: I'll DM facilities for badge and add guest to Zoom as a registrant.

carmen_l: All set on my end. See you all tomorrow.

maya_k: Thanks team :thumbsup: Will send final invite with updates tonight.
